# Session Log Canvas Coupling Map

Read this map when a schema diff, release note, or session check shows a change. Paths are relative to this file. The canvas root is [extensions/hve-core/session-log](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/).

## Where Copilot Describes Its Session Data

Each installed Copilot package (`<COPILOT_HOME or ~/.copilot>/pkg/<platform>/<version>/`) and the package VS Code bundles (`@github/copilot-sdk-<platform>`) carry:

| File                                        | What it tells you                                                  |
|---------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `schemas/session-events.schema.json`        | Every event type, its `data` fields, and whether it is ephemeral   |
| `changelog.json` (CLI package)              | Release notes per version                                          |
| `copilot-sdk/generated/session-events.d.ts` | The same event types as TypeScript                                 |
| `copilot-sdk/generated/rpc.d.ts`            | Session RPC methods, including the canvas open and action requests |
| `copilot-sdk/canvas.d.ts`                   | `createCanvas`, canvas actions, `CanvasError`, and the open result |
| `copilot-sdk/extension.d.ts`                | `joinSession` and the extension entry contract                     |
| `copilot-sdk/docs/extensions.md`            | Extension and canvas authoring guidance                            |

## Surfaces and Dependents

| Surface                       | Recorded as                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | Canvas code                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Tests                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
|-------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Storage location              | `<COPILOT_HOME or ~/.copilot>/session-state/<session id>/`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | [lib/paths.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/lib/paths.mjs)                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | [tests/paths.test.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/tests/paths.test.mjs)                                                                                                                                |
| Session list metadata         | `workspace.yaml` (`name`, `summary`, `cwd`, `repository`, `branch`, `client_name`, `updated_at`) and `inuse.<pid>.lock`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | [lib/sessions.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/lib/sessions.mjs) (`CLIENT_LABELS`; activity from live `inuse.<pid>.lock` files, also returned by each `GET /api/poll` answer as `active`), [lib/yaml.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/lib/yaml.mjs)                     | [tests/sessions.test.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/tests/sessions.test.mjs) and server tests (poll activity)                                                                                         |
| Event envelope                | `events.jsonl` lines with `type`, `data`, `id`, `timestamp`, `parentId`, and `agentId` for subagents. The log only grows by appending: a replaced, shortened, or same-size-changed file is indexed again under a new epoch                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | [lib/indexer.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/lib/indexer.mjs) (`SessionIndex`, `HANDLED_EVENT_TYPES`); `GET /api/poll` `epoch`, `next`, and `more`                                                                                                                                  | [tests/indexer.test.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/tests/indexer.test.mjs), [tests/fixtures.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/tests/fixtures.mjs), and server tests (eviction and paging) |
| Prompts, responses, and turns | `user.message`, `assistant.message`, `assistant.turn_start`, `assistant.turn_end`, `session.usage_record`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | Indexer `#apply` and `withBodies`; [ui/render.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/ui/render.mjs) entry kinds                                                                                                                                                                            | Indexer and server tests                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Tool calls                    | `tool.execution_start`, `tool.execution_complete` (`result.content`, `result.detailedContent`, `error`), `external_tool.*`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | Indexer tool cases and `#toolPreview`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | Indexer tests (previews)                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Subagents                     | `subagent.*` events with `agentId`; `subagent.started.data.toolCallId` links the spawning call                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Indexer subagent cases and `#linkSubagent`; agent tree in [ui/app.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/ui/app.mjs)                                                                                                                                                                       | Indexer tests (nesting)                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Hooks                         | `hook.start` and `hook.end` (`hookInvocationId`, `hookType`, `input`, `output`, `error`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | Indexer hook pairing and `PRE_TURN_HOOKS`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | Indexer tests (hook runs)                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Session lifecycle             | `session.start`, `session.resume` (a root resume clears the earlier shutdown totals and end time; the shutdown entry stays in the log), `session.shutdown` (`shutdownType`, request and duration totals)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | Indexer session cases and `getSummary` `session`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | Indexer tests (shutdown and resume)                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Compaction                    | `session.compaction_start`, `session.compaction_complete`, and the compaction call's `model.messages_snapshot`; the optional `compactionAttemptId` pairs a start with its completion, and a completion without a matching ID pairs with the agent's running compaction                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | Indexer compaction cases, `pickCompactionRequest`, `readCompactionText`; `GET /api/compaction` in [lib/server.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/lib/server.mjs)                                                                                                                       | Indexer and server compaction tests                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| System prompt                 | `system.message` `content` and `contentBlocks`: tagged sections, `<available_skills>`, the instruction file table, `<agent_instructions>`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | Indexer `analyzeSystemPrompt`, `diffSections`, and prompt versions (the newest 500 kept, numbered from a running total, older ones re-read from their entries); `GET /api/system-prompt`                                                                                                          | Indexer tests (prompt analysis and versions)                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Model and context             | `session.start`, `session.model_change`, `session.usage_record`, `session.usage_checkpoint` (`promptCacheBreakState`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | Indexer model, usage, and context tracking; `getRecordedInventory`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | Indexer and inventory tests                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Live inventories              | `session.rpc`: `agent.list`, `agent.getCurrent`, `skills.list`, `skills.getInvoked`, `instructions.getSources`, `mcp.list`, `plugins.list`, `extensions.list`, `model.getCurrent`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | [lib/inventory.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/lib/inventory.mjs) (`createLiveInventoryProvider`)                                                                                                                                                                                   | [tests/inventory.test.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/tests/inventory.test.mjs)                                                                                                                        |
| Live definitions              | `session.rpc`: `tools.getCurrentMetadata` (`name`, `description`, `input_schema`, `mcpServerName`, `mcpToolName`, `deferLoading`), `agent.list` with `includePrompt`, `skills.list`, `instructions.getSources` (`content`), `canvas.list` (`canvasId`, `displayName`, `description`, `inputSchema`, `actions`, `extensionId`), `mcp.list` (`status`, `url`, `error`, `serverMetadata.instructions`), `plugins.list`, `extensions.list`; the `task` tool's `agent_type` enum and its "Available agent types" and "User-provided custom agents" lines (`- **name**:`)                                                                | [lib/definitions.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/lib/definitions.mjs) (`createLiveDefinitionProvider` `lookup` and `catalog`, `projectDefinition`, `agentListing`, `subagentCatalog`); `GET /api/definition`                                                                        | [tests/definitions.test.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/tests/definitions.test.mjs) and server tests                                                                                                   |
| Recorded definitions          | `skill.invoked` (`content`, `path`, `allowedTools`, `trigger`, `invokedAtTurn`) and `skill.invoked_ref` (`contentId`), `skill.context_delivered` (`content`, the complete delivered text) and `skill.context_delivered_ref` (`contentId`, `prefix`, `suffix`) matched to the receiving agent by `agentId` and to the load by content ID, `<skill>` entries and the instruction table in `system.message`, `session.usage_checkpoint` tool `schema_hash`, tool call parts (latest call arguments and result), the opening text of a subagent's `system.message` and the root `<agent_instructions>` block (delivered agent prompts) | Indexer `getDefinition`, `skillPromptEntry`, `instructionPromptEntry`, `leadingPromptText`, `agentInstructionsBlock`, `agentNameKey`                                                                                                                                                              | Indexer tests (recorded definitions)                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Recorded inventories          | `<canvas>` entries (`<id>`, `<name>`, `<description>`) in `system.message`; `open_canvas`, `invoke_canvas_action`, and `list_canvas_capabilities` arguments (`canvasId`, `instanceId`, `actionName`) and the capabilities JSON in `result.content`; `session.canvas.recorded` and `session.canvas.removed`; `tool.execution_start` `mcpServerName`; `view` `path` arguments; `system.notification` `instruction_discovered`; `tool_search.activated` `toolNames`; root `subagent.selected`; `hook.end` `error.source` and `output.additionalContext`                                                                               | Indexer `analyzeSystemPrompt`, `canvasPromptEntry`, `getRecordedInventory`, `getReadCounts`, and the canvas, hook, MCP, and read records; [lib/context.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/lib/context.mjs) (`buildContextSections`); `GET /api/inventory` `sections` and `part=counts` | Indexer, [tests/context.test.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/tests/context.test.mjs), and server tests                                                                                                 |
| Canvas SDK                    | `@github/copilot-sdk/extension`: `joinSession`, `createCanvas`, `CanvasError`, the open request `sessionId`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | [extension.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/extension.mjs), [lib/lifecycle.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/lib/lifecycle.mjs), [lib/actions.mjs](../../../extensions/hve-core/session-log/lib/actions.mjs)                                                             | Lifecycle, actions, and static tests                                                                                                                                                                                 |
